title: Seahawks, Rams favored in wide-open SB LXI field

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Seahawks, Rams favored in wide-open SB LXI field
sources.description: The Seahawks are tied with the Rams at +950 to win Super Bowl LXI, followed by the Bills at +1100, and the Eagles, Ravens and Patriots tied at +1300, according to DraftKings odds.
